title: Heat Pump Hustle: Taxpayers On The Hook For Tech That Falls Flat In The Cold
summary: NH Journal (2025) critique of New England heat pump subsidies: gas cheaper in most states, high install cost, backup heat in the cold.

assertions.quote: natural gas heating remained more affordable than heat pumps in 41 states, including New Hampshire and the rest of New England.
New Hampshire residents pay among the highest electricity prices in the country.
even supporters acknowledge that heat pumps are pricey to install, with costs typically ranging from $8,000 to $15,000.
most households that adopt heat pumps in colder regions still rely on a backup heating source

The group estimates families abandoning fuel oil or propane could save closer to $1,000 annually.
